source: 21cmFAST 4.3.2 Lagrangian thermal radiation, homogeneous ACG photon history

integral_contract.mass_range: Integrate d ln M from log(minimum_source_mass(z, true)) to log(1e16 Msun). For these mass-dependent, non-MCG models the lower limit in mass units is M_TURN_STELLAR_FEEDBACK/50 with M_MIN_in_Mass; otherwise TtoM(z, X_RAY_Tvir_MIN, mu)/50, mu=1.22 below 9999.99 K and 0.6 otherwise.
integral_contract.weight: Sheth-Tormen unconditional mass function times exp(lnM + capped log stellar weight + capped log escape weight - Mturn/M). Mturn is max(atomic cooling mass, M_TURN_STELLAR_FEEDBACK). The native integral uses QAG, then multiplies by fstar_10_acg*fesc_10_acg*pop2_ion.
integral_contract.normalization: Radiation setup calls set_scaling_constants(zp, sc, false). The capped stellar and escape power laws use the native precomputed saturation masses and the 1e10 Msun pivot. The sampled-galaxy upper-mass stellar turnover and the metallicity-dependent X-ray luminosity do not enter this native mass weight.
integral_contract.gpu: global_rows supplies the evolved growth, lower mass and turnover for each redshift. global_source_table uses the shared v3 adaptive quadrature with the native mass variance/slope grids and relative integration tolerance 1e-3.

table_method: Instrument one setup from the archived physical source history. Snapshot the native double table immediately after the native routine, then run normal stage 18 and compare all 400 entries plus both header values at the same native address. A separate production-style replay omitted the native table entirely, so CUDA allocated it on demand.
timing_note: Per-table timings in the audit include callback and copies on CUDA. The single-node measurements serve validation rather than throughput estimation.
